question: How many completed migrations involved instances that are currently in the “shelved_offloaded” VM state, have network information cached (i.e., the instance has a matching row in INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES), and are running on host “blaze8-12”? Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS migration_count
FROM migrations m
JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid
WHERE m.status = 'completed'
  AND i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded'
  AND i.host = 'blaze8-12'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM instance_info_caches ic
    WHERE ic.instance_uuid = i.uuid
  );

q1.host_migration_status, q1.display_name, q1.avg_coefficient_of_variation, q1.row_count, q2.max_completed_migration_memory_total FROM q1 LEFT JOIN q2 ON q2.display_name = q1.display_name ORDER BY WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.INSTANCE_UUID, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.`KEY` AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, AVG(m.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY m.INSTANCE_UUID ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM `migrations` AS m JOIN `instances` AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ORDER BY m.ID), instance_rollup AS (SELECT INSTANCE_UUID, COUNT(*) AS total_metadata_rows, AVG(window_column) AS avg_running_avg_migration_id FROM inner_cte GROUP BY INSTANCE_UUID) SELECT ic.migration_id, ic.INSTANCE_UUID, ic.SOURCE_COMPUTE, ic.DEST_COMPUTE, ic.instance_display_name, ic.metadata_key, ic.metadata_value, ic.window_column, ir.total_metadata_rows, ir.avg_running_avg_migration_id FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN instance_rollup AS ir ON ic.INSTANCE_UUID = ir.INSTANCE_UUID ORDER BY ic.migration_id), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ism.`KEY` AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.UUID ORDER BY ism.`KEY`) AS window_column FROM `instance_extra` AS ie JOIN `instances` AS i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12') SELECT inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.hostname, inner_cte.instance_extra_id, inner_cte.metadata_key, inner_cte.metadata_value, inner_cte.window_column, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM `instance_system_metadata` AS ism2 JOIN `instances` AS i2 ON ism2.INSTANCE_UUID = i2.UUID WHERE ism2.INSTANCE_UUID = inner_cte.instance_uuid AND ism2.DELETED <> 0) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_deleted_system_metadata FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.metadata_key) SELECT q2.hostname, q2.instance_uuid, q2.instance_extra_id, q2.metadata_key, q2.metadata_value, q2.window_column AS running_avg_instance_memory_mb, q2.has_deleted_system_metadata, q1.migration_id, q1.SOURCE_COMPUTE, q1.DEST_COMPUTE, q1.instance_display_name, q1.window_column AS running_avg_migration_id, q1.total_metadata_rows, q1.avg_running_avg_migration_id, ROUND(q1.avg_running_avg_migration_id / NULLIF(q2.window_column, 0), 6) AS normalized_avg_migration_id_per_running_avg_memory FROM q2 JOIN q1 ON q1.INSTANCE_UUID = q2.instance_uuid AND q1.metadata_key = q2.metadata_key AND q1.metadata_value = q2.metadata_value ORDER BY normalized_avg_migration_id_per_running_avg_memory DESC, q2.instance_uuid, q2.metadata_key, q1.migration_id

WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.DISPLAY_NAME, t0.VALUE AS metadata_value, t2.NETWORK_INFO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.VALUE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `instance_system_metadata` AS t0 JOIN `instances` AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t0.`KEY` = 'image_image_type' AND t1.host = 'blaze8-12'), avg_meta AS (SELECT AVG(CAST(metadata_value AS FLOAT)) AS avg_metadata_value FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.metadata_value, ic.NETWORK_INFO, ic.window_column, (CAST(ic.metadata_value AS FLOAT) - am.avg_metadata_value) AS deviation_from_avg_metadata_value FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN avg_meta AS am), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(migration_metadata_count) - MIN(migration_metadata_count) AS metadata_count_range, VARIANCE(migration_metadata_count) AS metadata_count_variance, STDDEV(migration_metadata_count) AS metadata_count_stddev FROM `instances` AS i JOIN (SELECT m.instance_uuid, m.id AS migration_id, COUNT(ism.id) AS migration_metadata_count FROM `migrations` AS m JOIN `instances` AS i2 ON m.instance_uuid = i2.uuid JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON i2.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND REGEXP_LIKE(i2.display_name, 'prime') GROUP BY m.instance_uuid, m.id) AS per_migration_stats ON i.uuid = per_migration_stats.instance_uuid GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY metadata_count_range DESC) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.metadata_count_range, inner_cte.metadata_count_variance, inner_cte.metadata_count_stddev, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM `migrations` AS m2 JOIN `instances` AS i3 ON m2.instance_uuid = i3.uuid WHERE i3.display_name = inner_cte.display_name AND m2.deleted = 0 AND NOT m2.status IN ('completed', 'failed', 'error')) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_active_migrations FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.metadata_count_range DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT q1.DISPLAY_NAME, q1.metadata_value, q1.NETWORK_INFO, q1.window_column, q1.deviation_from_avg_metadata_value, q2.metadata_count_range, q2.metadata_count_variance, q2.metadata_count_stddev, q2.has_active_migrations FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.DISPLAY_NAME = q2.display_name

WITH HostCompletedMigrations AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.INSTANCE_UUID, m.MIGRATION_TYPE, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, m.MEMORY_TOTAL, MIN(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) OVER (PARTITION BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE ORDER BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE) AS window_column FROM `migrations` AS m JOIN `instances` AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12'), FlareCompletedMigrations AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.INSTANCE_UUID, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, ie.FLAVOR, AVG(m.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY m.INSTANCE_UUID ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM `migrations` AS m JOIN `instances` AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.DISPLAY_NAME, 'flare') ORDER BY m.ID) SELECT hcm.MIGRATION_TYPE, COUNT(DISTINCT hcm.migration_id) AS Completed_Migration_Count, ROUND(AVG(hcm.MEMORY_MB), 0) AS Avg_Instance_Memory_MB, ROUND(AVG(hcm.VCPUS), 2) AS Avg_Instance_VCPUs, ROUND(AVG(hcm.window_column), 2) AS Avg_Min_MemoryTotal_By_Type, ROUND(AVG(fcm.window_column), 2) AS Avg_Running_Avg_MigrationId_For_Flare FROM HostCompletedMigrations AS hcm LEFT JOIN FlareCompletedMigrations AS fcm ON hcm.INSTANCE_UUID = fcm.INSTANCE_UUID AND hcm.migration_id = fcm.migration_id WHERE REGEXP_LIKE(hcm.DISPLAY_NAME, 'flare') GROUP BY hcm.MIGRATION_TYPE ORDER BY Completed_Migration_Count DESC

projection_contract.role: aggregation role: count of completed migrations involved instances

predicate_contract.role: filter role: currently in the “shelved_offloaded” VM state, have network information cached (i.e., the instance has a matching row in INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES)

historical_programs.sql_template: WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.ID AS instance_id, i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.USER_ID, i.PROJECT_ID, i.HOSTNAME, i.VM_STATE, i.POWER_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, c.ID AS info_cache_id, c.NETWORK_INFO, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.PROJECT_ID ORDER BY i.PROJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge'), ZoneAverages AS (SELECT i2.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, AVG(i2.MEMORY_MB * 1.0) AS avg_zone_memory_mb FROM `instances` AS i2 WHERE i2.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' GROUP BY i2.AVAILABILITY_ZONE) SELECT inner_cte.instance_id, inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.USER_ID, inner_cte.PROJECT_ID, inner_cte.HOSTNAME, inner_cte.VM_STATE, inner_cte.POWER_STATE, inner_cte.MEMORY_MB, inner_cte.VCPUS, inner_cte.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, inner_cte.info_cache_id, inner_cte.NETWORK_INFO, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN ZoneAverages AS za ON za.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = inner_cte.AVAILABILITY_ZONE WHERE inner_cte.MEMORY_MB > za.avg_zone_memory_mb), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_instance_memory_mb, SUM(m.MEMORY_PROCESSED) AS total_migration_memory_processed FROM `migrations` AS m JOIN `instances` AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded') SELECT i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, inner_cte.min_instance_memory_mb, inner_cte.total_migration_memory_processed, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM `migrations` AS m2 JOIN `instances` AS i2 ON m2.INSTANCE_UUID = i2.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS ic2 ON i2.UUID = ic2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m2.STATUS = 'completed' AND i2.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' AND ic2.DELETED = 0) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_network_info_cache FROM inner_cte JOIN `instances` AS i ON i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, inner_cte.min_instance_memory_mb, inner_cte.total_migration_memory_processed) SELECT q1.instance_id, q1.instance_uuid, q1.user_id, q1.project_id, q1.hostname, q1.vm_state, q1.power_state, q1.memory_mb, q1.vcpus, q1.availability_zone, q1.info_cache_id, q1.network_info, q1.window_column AS min_memory_mb_within_project, q2.min_instance_memory_mb AS shelved_offloaded_min_instance_memory_mb, q2.total_migration_memory_processed, q2.has_network_info_cache FROM q1 LEFT JOIN q2 ON q2.vm_state = q1.vm_state WHERE q1.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded' ORDER BY q1.availability_zone, q1.project_id, q1.instance_id

WITH blaze_host_minmax AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.HOSTNAME AS instance_hostname, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE AS migration_source_compute, m.DEST_COMPUTE AS migration_dest_compute, m.DEST_HOST AS migration_dest_host, m.MIGRATION_TYPE AS migration_type, m.MEMORY_TOTAL AS memory_total, m.MEMORY_PROCESSED AS memory_processed, m.MEMORY_REMAINING AS memory_remaining, MIN(m.MEMORY_REMAINING) OVER (PARTITION BY m.INSTANCE_UUID ORDER BY m.INSTANCE_UUID) AS window_column FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `migrations` AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12') SELECT i.HOST AS instance_host, MAX(inner_cte.window_column) AS max_of_instance_min_memory_remaining FROM inner_cte JOIN `instances` AS i ON i.UUID = inner_cte.instance_uuid GROUP BY i.HOST), ether_dest_compute_details AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, m.INSTANCE_UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.VM_STATE AS instance_vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS instance_vcpus, ism.`KEY` AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, m.MEMORY_REMAINING AS migration_memory_remaining, MIN(m.MEMORY_REMAINING) OVER (PARTITION BY m.DEST_COMPUTE ORDER BY m.DEST_COMPUTE) AS window_column FROM `migrations` AS m JOIN `instances` AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'ether-18') SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(DEST_COMPUTE) OVER (ORDER BY DEST_COMPUTE, migration_id, metadata_key) = DEST_COMPUTE THEN NULL ELSE DEST_COMPUTE END AS dest_compute, migration_id, migration_status, SOURCE_COMPUTE, DEST_HOST, INSTANCE_UUID, instance_display_name, instance_vm_state, instance_memory_mb, instance_vcpus, metadata_key, metadata_value, migration_memory_remaining, window_column AS min_migration_memory_remaining_in_dest_compute, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY DEST_COMPUTE) AS total_rows_in_dest_compute FROM inner_cte ORDER BY DEST_COMPUTE, migration_id, metadata_key) SELECT ed.dest_compute, ed.total_rows_in_dest_compute, ed.min_migration_memory_remaining_in_dest_compute, bh.instance_host AS blaze_instance_host, bh.max_of_instance_min_memory_remaining, ROUND(ed.min_migration_memory_remaining_in_dest_compute / NULLIF(bh.max_of_instance_min_memory_remaining, 0), 4) AS min_dest_compute_memory_remaining_to_blaze_max_instance_min_ratio FROM ether_dest_compute_details AS ed CROSS JOIN blaze_host_minmax AS bh ORDER BY ed.dest_compute, ed.migration_id, ed.metadata_key

WITH StateRollup AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ism.`KEY` AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, MAX(ie.ID) OVER (ORDER BY i.UUID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_instance_extra_id_next_2 FROM `instance_extra` AS ie JOIN `instances` AS i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND ism.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12'), StateCounts AS (SELECT inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.power_state, COUNT(DISTINCT inner_cte.instance_uuid) AS total_instances FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.power_state) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(vm_state) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE vm_state END AS vm_state, CASE WHEN GROUPING(power_state) = 1 AND GROUPING(vm_state) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE CAST(power_state AS CHAR) END AS power_state, SUM(total_instances) AS total_instances FROM StateCounts GROUP BY vm_state, power_state WITH ROLLUP), MigrationCV AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.vm_state, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) / NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `migrations` AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.vm_state HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, COUNT(m2.id) AS completed_migration_count FROM inner_cte JOIN `instances` AS i2 ON i2.vm_state = inner_cte.vm_state JOIN `migrations` AS m2 ON m2.instance_uuid = i2.uuid WHERE m2.status = 'completed' AND i2.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation ORDER BY inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT sr.vm_state, sr.power_state, sr.total_instances, mc.coefficient_of_variation, mc.completed_migration_count FROM StateRollup AS sr LEFT JOIN MigrationCV AS mc ON mc.vm_state = sr.vm_state ORDER BY CASE WHEN sr.vm_state = 'GRAND TOTAL' THEN 2 WHEN sr.power_state = 'SUBTOTAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, sr.vm_state, sr.power_state

WITH CompletedMigrationsOnBlaze AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.INSTANCE_UUID, m.MIGRATION_TYPE, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, m.MEMORY_TOTAL, MIN(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) OVER (PARTITION BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE ORDER BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE) AS window_column FROM `migrations` AS m JOIN `instances` AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12'), MemoryStatsByDisplayNameOnBlaze AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.`KEY` = 'image_image_type' AND ism.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC), CombinedResults AS (SELECT cm.migration_id, cm.INSTANCE_UUID, cm.MIGRATION_TYPE, cm.SOURCE_COMPUTE, cm.DEST_COMPUTE, cm.DEST_HOST, cm.DISPLAY_NAME, cm.VM_STATE, cm.MEMORY_MB, cm.VCPUS, cm.instance_extra_id, cm.MEMORY_TOTAL, cm.window_column, ms.memory_mb_variance, ms.memory_mb_stddev FROM CompletedMigrationsOnBlaze AS cm LEFT JOIN MemoryStatsByDisplayNameOnBlaze AS ms ON ms.DISPLAY_NAME = cm.DISPLAY_NAME) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY migration_id, DISPLAY_NAME

WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.root_gb) / NULLIF(AVG(i.root_gb), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE ism.`key` = 'image_image_type' AND iic.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(i.root_gb) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC), Enriched AS (SELECT ic.display_name, ism2.value AS image_type, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM `migrations` AS m WHERE (m.source_compute = i.host OR m.dest_compute = i.host) AND m.deleted = 0 AND NOT m.status IN ('completed', 'failed', 'error')) THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Inactive' END AS host_migration_status, ic.coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN `instances` AS i ON i.display_name = ic.display_name AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism2 ON ism2.instance_uuid = i.uuid AND ism2.`key` = 'image_image_type' AND ism2.deleted = 0 JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS iic2 ON iic2.instance_uuid = i.uuid AND iic2.deleted = 0) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(image_type) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE image_type END AS image_type, CASE WHEN GROUPING(host_migration_status) = 1 AND GROUPING(image_type) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE host_migration_status END AS host_migration_status, CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(host_migration_status) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE display_name END AS display_name, AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation, COUNT(*) AS row_count FROM Enriched GROUP BY image_type, host_migration_status, display_name WITH ROLLUP), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(m.memory_total) AS max_memory_total, m.status FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `migrations` AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.display_name, 'prime') GROUP BY i.display_name, m.status HAVING MAX(m.memory_total) > 0) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, MAX(inner_cte.max_memory_total) AS max_completed_migration_memory_total FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.display_name) SELECT q1.image_type, q1.host_migration_status, q1.display_name, q1.avg_coefficient_of_variation, q1.row_count, q2.max_completed_migration_memory_total FROM q1 LEFT JOIN q2 ON q2.display_name = q1.display_name ORDER BY q1.image_type, q1.host_migration_status, q1.display_name

WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.INSTANCE_UUID, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.`KEY` AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, AVG(m.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY m.INSTANCE_UUID ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM `migrations` AS m JOIN `instances` AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ORDER BY m.ID), instance_rollup AS (SELECT INSTANCE_UUID, COUNT(*) AS total_metadata_rows, AVG(window_column) AS avg_running_avg_migration_id FROM inner_cte GROUP BY INSTANCE_UUID) SELECT ic.migration_id, ic.INSTANCE_UUID, ic.SOURCE_COMPUTE, ic.DEST_COMPUTE, ic.instance_display_name, ic.metadata_key, ic.metadata_value, ic.window_column, ir.total_metadata_rows, ir.avg_running_avg_migration_id FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN instance_rollup AS ir ON ic.INSTANCE_UUID = ir.INSTANCE_UUID ORDER BY ic.migration_id), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ism.`KEY` AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.UUID ORDER BY ism.`KEY`) AS window_column FROM `instance_extra` AS ie JOIN `instances` AS i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12') SELECT inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.hostname, inner_cte.instance_extra_id, inner_cte.metadata_key, inner_cte.metadata_value, inner_cte.window_column, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM `instance_system_metadata` AS ism2 JOIN `instances` AS i2 ON ism2.INSTANCE_UUID = i2.UUID WHERE ism2.INSTANCE_UUID = inner_cte.instance_uuid AND ism2.DELETED <> 0) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_deleted_system_metadata FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.metadata_key) SELECT q2.hostname, q2.instance_uuid, q2.instance_extra_id, q2.metadata_key, q2.metadata_value, q2.window_column AS running_avg_instance_memory_mb, q2.has_deleted_system_metadata, q1.migration_id, q1.SOURCE_COMPUTE, q1.DEST_COMPUTE, q1.instance_display_name, q1.window_column AS running_avg_migration_id, q1.total_metadata_rows, q1.avg_running_avg_migration_id, ROUND(q1.avg_running_avg_migration_id / NULLIF(q2.window_column, 0), 6) AS normalized_avg_migration_id_per_running_avg_memory FROM q2 JOIN q1 ON q1.INSTANCE_UUID = q2.instance_uuid AND q1.metadata_key = q2.metadata_key AND q1.metadata_value
